sections.overview: This dragonfly in the skimmer family Libellulidae has a close genus-mate, Erythrodiplax media, profiled alongside it.
sections.identification: ITIS accepts Erythrodiplax ines as a species; older literature also used the combination E. connata ines, so names in historical records need care.
sections.habitat: The Napo survey records it near marshy high-elevation streams.
sections.diet: The occurrence records consulted do not describe this species’ diet.
sections.behavior: The cited field survey reports occurrences, not species-specific behaviour.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted here do not establish its breeding behaviour or life cycle.
sections.ecology: The occurrence survey does not test its ecology; compare E. media only by recorded settings.
sections.conservation: A regional Colombian assessment lists E. ines as Least Concern; that local category should not be read as a global assessment.
